title: Level 4 (Expert) - B-15
notes:
West leads the ♦K against 4♠. West's diamond opening lead is won by the ♦A. If West has the ♥A, South is in danger of losing 3 heart tricks and a club trick.

If clubs are 3-3, North's club holding will provide a discard for 1 of South's hearts. South should make an effort to develop the clubs without allowing East on lead. A heart lead from East would not be welcome.

South should cross to dummy and play a diamond. If East follows low South will discard a club, a loser on a loser.South will now be able to test for 3-3 clubs without allowing East to gain the lead. Dummy's diamond play is covered by East and South ruffs. South should cross to the dummy in clubs and play North's last diamond. This time East follows low and South discards his club loser.

West will win and exit in trump. Dummy's remaining club honor is cashed and a club is high ruffed by South. When clubs are 3-3, the last trump can be drawn ending in the dummy. North's good club will take care of 1 of South's losing hearts. If clubs are 4-2, North's spade entry can be used to lead a heart towards the ♥K.
